title: Tailwinds and Tides | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home is thoughtfully designed for both entertainment and relaxation. The first floor features a lively game and entertainment lounge with a pool table, bar, beverage fridge, and multiple big-screen TVs, opening directly to the outdoor pool area and a covered outdoor kitchen ideal for poolside dining. Upstairs, the bright open-concept living space showcases plush seating, a modern fireplace, and balcony views overlooking the pool. A beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen with premium appliances and an oversized island anchors the space, while a private elevator provides effortless access to every floor, making this coastal escape as comfortable as it is unforgettable. Coastal luxury meets relaxed beach living in this beautifully designed retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach, one of 30A’s most beloved communities. Surrounded by quiet streets, charming beach cottages, and the natural beauty of Florida’s emerald coast, the home offers the perfect setting for unforgettable gatherings. Guests can unwind beside a private resort-style pool and hot tub, enjoy evenings on the rooftop deck with sweeping views, or take advantage of the included bikes and golf cart for easy trips to the nearby sugar-white sand and turquoise water. Complimentary beach setups add an extra layer of convenience for days spent by the shore.
